explanation: The AI response failed to provide most of the expected species (Gardnerycteris crenulatum, Lonchorhina aurita, Phyllostomus elongatus, Phyllostomus hastatus), providing only Lophostoma silvicolum correctly. It also incorrectly listed Carollia sp. and Chrotopterus auritus as the only other Phyllostominae species recorded.
